updates.title: Website 2.0 - Cozy Realm Expands!
updates.text:
It has been over half a year and both the comic and website have grown considerably. The comic has seen weekly upload streak that continues to this day, introducing a lot of new things and new characters. The website has evolved into a far more feature rich home for the comic as well. 

The following are some of the new things I have added so far:
- New Welcome page with Cast Info
- Full separation of logic of data and code
- Fully overhauled wiki engine that assembles pages instead of hard coding
- Download section with a 3D print model of Fluff!
- Living Map feature of the Cozy Realm which will update with new places when seen in new comics
- Better comic preview navigation
- More formatting support for text on the site
- And many bug fixes, Qol changes and optimisations

There is only one more feature to be added in the future which I always wished for and that will come in due time, won't spoil it. It's crazy how much this project has grown for a small and simple amateur comic. Hopefully it will grow into a known and beloved comic online one day, but even if it does not, I will remain it's #1 fan!

updates.title: Website 1.0
updates.text:
The website is finally 1.0! Can't believe it finally happened, procrastination is quite a curse indeed. Themes work, stars shine and mobile version is responsive. Wiki is done in the meantime. Episode 1 is live which marks the first ever exposure of my franchise to the world. Something that I was making a hobby for a few years, on and off. Plenty more to come soon.

This is digital art made with Krita software and a Wacom tablet. No AI was used in its creation, neither for art nor for lore.
